input.prompt: A single 3x3 numbered nine-panel lineart contact sheet (9:16, 1152x2048) of one over-ear wireless headphone product, drawn as clean thin black outline lineart on pure white, no shading, no color, no material rendering. Each cell is a separate composition of the same headphone, each cell labelled with a small number 1-9 in its top-left corner. Panel 1: straight-on front view, both earcups facing camera, headband arch fully visible, earcup outer shells and cushion rims seen edge-on. Panel 2: three-quarter front view from the left side, one earcup outer shell dominant, the other partly hidden behind it, headband arch foreshortened. Panel 3: pure side profile, one earcup outer shell flat to camera, headband arch as a C shape, the far earcup completely hidden. Panel 4: rear view, inner faces of both earcups and the inside of the headband visible, outer shells hidden. Panel 5: camera directly above looking vertically down, headband arch seen as a narrow band, both earcup tops visible, earcup cushions and inner faces hidden from this camera. Panel 6: low angle from below, earcup undersides and the bottom of the headband visible, top of the headband hidden. Panel 7: tight close-up of one earcup outer shell with the yoke hinge and slider joint, rest of the headphone cropped out of frame. Panel 8: close-up of the headband crown and its padded underside, earcups cropped out of frame. Panel 9: headphone folded flat for storage, earcups rotated inward, compact silhouette. Consistent proportions and identical product across all nine cells, thin uniform line weight, generous white margins, no text other than the panel numbers.
